acceptance.offByDefault: Hook starts paused at 00:00; component labels timer personal and optional.
acceptance.controls: Start/resume, pause, reset, hide, and show controls verified by component and browser tests.
acceptance.monotonicState: Elapsed delta uses performance.now() when available; wall-clock drift test passes; interval repaint does not define elapsed time.
acceptance.lifecycle: visibilitychange pauses safely; reload restores paused elapsed state through sessionStore; unmount persists paused snapshot.
acceptance.multipleTabs: BroadcastChannel owner election test passes; one tab remains running and competing tab adopts paused owner state.
acceptance.accessibility: Named SVG, text-equivalent elapsed value, status state, keyboard controls, visible focus, reduced-motion CSS, and 44px controls verified.
acceptance.isolation: Timer component/hook has no Worker, fetch, database, secret, runtime command, response, result, integrity, telemetry, or analytics path; browser observed zero /book-runtime/commands requests during timer-only actions.
acceptance.rollback: Hide and reset remove/disable timer UI state without touching runtime records; no trusted action is enabled.

checks.result: 4 tests passed; includes desktop, 375px, 320px, collapse/tab/reload, focus, overflow, touch-target, and request-isolation proof
